title: Diffusion-Based Multiple-Shooting Indirect Optimal Control for Fuel-Optimal Spacecraft Trajectory Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models (DMs) have found applications in control problems, and in particular robotics, where the DMs enable exploration of possible control solutions. A critical shortcoming of these applications is that they have lacked optimality guarantees. This is a problem for their potential use in fuel-optimal spacecraft trajectories that are characterized with long time-horizons and bang-bang profiles. Alternatively, indirect optimal control methods ensure explicit satisfaction of necessary conditions, but are highly sensitive to the initial costate estimation needed to solve the resulting Hamiltonian boundary-value problems (HBVPs). To alleviate this sensitivity and enlarge the convergence domain of HBVPs, advanced indirect methods have been developed that use smoothing approaches and continuation. translated_title: 基于扩散模型的多重打靶间接最优控制方法用于燃料最优航天器轨迹生成
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的生成模型（DMs）已被应用于控制问题，特别是机器人学领域，扩散模型能够探索可能的控制解决方案。这些应用的一个关键缺点是它们缺乏最优性保证。这对于它们在燃料最优航天器轨迹中的潜在应用是一个问题，因为这类轨迹通常具有长时间跨度和大砰-砰开关式推力曲线的特征。另一方面，间接最优控制方法能够明确满足最优性必要条件，但对求解由此产生的哈密顿边值问题（HBVPs）所需的初始协态估计高度敏感。为了减轻这种敏感性并扩大HBVPs的收敛域，研究者们已经开发了采用平滑技术和同伦延拓方法的高级间接方法。我们提出了一种基于扩散的多重打靶间接控制方法，该方法结合了扩散模型的探索能力……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将扩散模型的探索能力与多重打靶间接最优控制相结合的新方法，在生成燃料最优航天器轨迹的同时，有效缓解了传统间接法对初始协态估计的高度敏感性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a diffusion-based multiple shooting indirect optimal control method that combines the exploration capability of diffusion models with indirect optimal control to generate fuel-optimal spacecraft trajectories, alleviating the high sensitivity to initial costate estimation in traditional indirect methods.
